run_download_and_prepare: run the download_and_prepare script to build TensorFlow datasets via tfds build
run_download_and_prepare_with_imports: run download_and_prepare with --module_import flag to specify dataset module imports
run_download_and_prepare_with_dataset: run download_and_prepare with --dataset flag to specify a single dataset to build
run_download_and_prepare_with_config: run download_and_prepare with --builder_config_id flag to specify a builder config index
run_download_and_prepare_cli: run the download_and_prepare CLI entry point with argparse flags for dataset building
